thread:
Leah T.: Quick sync — we need to reassign a few postmortem action items because of upcoming rotations and a blocked infra dependency (new storage nodes delayed). I'll list items; please claim or request reassignment.

Omar H.: Thanks Leah. Which ones are blocked by hardware?

Leah T.: INFR-7012 (degenerate shard mitigation) is blocked by node procurement. Due dates will slip unless we scope a software-only mitigation.

Sofia G.: I can take a software mitigation spike for INFR-7012 (short timeframe): implement smarter shard hot-spot routing and throttling. Target: 10 business days.

Leah T.: Great, @Sofia G. please add acceptance criteria and a small benchmark in the ticket.

Ben R.: I'll pick up INFR-7013 (eviction telemetry + alerting). Short owner handoff since my rotation into platform is next week.

Omar H.: Heads up: Ben will be on rotation shadow week starting Mon. Ben, if you pick INFR-7013, can you delegate ongoing pager responsibility?

Ben R.: Yes — @Omar H. can be secondary on INFR-7013. I'll do initial PR and handover doc before I switch.

infra-bot: Reminder: rotation shadowing starts 2024-05-02 09:00 UTC for Ben R..

Leah T.: New RACI proposal for PM-812 (auto rollback play): Responsible = Sofia, Accountable = Leah, Consulted = Omar, Informed = Support. Thoughts?

Omar H.: That looks good. I'll review the rollback design and add feedback to PM-812.

Sofia G.: One ask: can we decouple rollback from the main deploy pipeline and test as an isolated feature-flip first? Less blast radius.

Leah T.: Agreed — add a feature-flagged rollout step in the ticket. Also add a short verification plan: canary + 10m latency/eviction SLO check.

Ben R.: INFR-7014 (runbook edits + oncall checklist) — I can draft the checklist but would like Support to review customer messaging. Assigning Support as reviewer.

Omar H.: Support review noted. Also add a recovery play for when rollback fails (manual shard reroute).

Sofia G.: For INFR-7012 spike, I'll create a branch `hotspot-routing/spike` and attach a mini-load spec. Need someone from SRE to run the staging test.

Omar H.: I'll take the SRE coordination for the staging run. Put the expected load numbers in the ticket.

Leah T.: Parent ticket INFR-7099 created to capture the recurring pattern and track all child tickets (INFR-7012/7013/7014/PM-812). Please link.

infra-bot: Parent INFR-7099 created and linked: INFR-7012, INFR-7013, INFR-7014, PM-812.

Ben R.: Quick process note: every ticket should include owner, due date, PR link, verification steps, and whether rotation affects ownership. Helps during handoffs.

Sofia G.: Noted. Also flagging a potential blocker: the staging cluster config differs from prod routing. If that's not fixed, load tests might not reproduce hot-shard behavior.

Leah T.: Good catch. Omar — can you note that as a staging blocker on INFR-7099 so we can prioritize the config sync?

Omar H.: Will do. Adding `staging-config-sync` to INFR-7099 and pinging eng-infra channel.

Leah T.: Follow-up: sync in two weeks to confirm progress and validate the runbook. If anyone needs to reassign before then, move the Jira and ping this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
